add.title: Add
add.remarks: If selected, the script is activated by the add event. The launch point must have at least one activation event, and you can select multiple events.

objectname.title: Object
objectname.remarks: The object that launches the script.

update.title: Update
update.remarks: If selected, the script is activated by the update event. The launch point must have at least one activation event, and you can select multiple events.

attributename.title: Attribute
attributename.remarks: Specify the attribute associated with the launch point.

actionname.title: Action
actionname.remarks: The action takes its name from the launch point, or you can modify the action name with the name of an existing action. When you create the script, a new action is saved in the database, and you can configure the action in the Actions application.

delete.title: Delete
delete.remarks: If selected, the script is activated by the delete event. The launch point must have at least one activation event, and you can select multiple events.

objectevent.title: Event
objectevent.remarks: Specify the event associated with the launch point

launchpointtype.title: Launch Point Type
launchpointtype.remarks: Specifies the type of launch point

condition.title: Object Event Condition
condition.remarks: A filter that identifies the set of records for the business object that is targeted by this script. The filter is expressed in the form of an SQL WHERE clause. You can enter this condition manually, or click the Detail Menu button to use the SQL Expression Builder.
